reentry_during_transfer_occurred.meaning: an external function was re-entered during the external transferFrom call

griefing_observed.meaning: the reported griefing outcome occurred as a result of the re-entry

assumptions: The external transferFrom call is the checkpoint at which re-entry is assessed.
The report's griefing outcome is treated as the forbidden effect of re-entry.

unresolved.description: The report does not define a concrete observable griefing outcome beyond the bare statement 'This enables griefing'; no magnitude, victim, or measurable state change is specified, so the effect predicate can only be a qualitative Boolean.
The report does not state whether the attacker is an authorized caller of addRewards or claimRewards, so no caller-authorization precondition can be grounded.

limitations: No frozen P sources were supplied, so the precondition set is empty.
The griefing impact is formalized only as a qualitative Boolean because the report gives no numeric or state-level definition.
Re-entry is represented as a single occurrence Boolean at the transferFrom checkpoint; the specific re-entered function is not distinguished.
